hero.name: Shir Zabolotny
hero.sub: I build software with careful decisions, from architecture to interface details, so products stay clear, maintainable, and natural to use.

about.label: About
paragraphs: With experience in tech companies and a Masters in Information Systems, I shaped my skills for building high quality software.

What truly guides my work is a **visual and intuitive sense** of how things should look, behave, and feel. I combine an **artistic eye** with **engineering thinking**, making decisions that keep software easy to evolve.
I am also **easy to work with**, I ask questions, I listen, and I care about making things clear.

ai.label: AI perspective
ai.introText: AI is powerful. It writes code fast, builds components, and suggest solutions in seconds. I use it too.
ai.introSub: But speed isn't the same as **direction**.

pillars.title: Continuity
pillars.text: Great products feel like one mind built them. Same logic. Same tone. Same patterns.

pillars.title: Anticipation
pillars.text: Users don't follow perfect paths. They hesitate, get confused, hit edge cases.
items: A professional **sees** problems before they happen

pillars.title: Intent
pillars.text: Every screen, interaction, and decision should have a reason behind it.

ai.footerText: AI saves time. A professional makes sure time is spent on the **right** thing.
